title: Meta's Waddle World is a Tamagotchi-like AI pet app

claims.claim: Meta has released a new Tamagotchi-like AI-powered pet-rearing game called Waddle World.

evidence.quote: The company has released a new Tamagotchi-like AI-powered pet-rearing game called Waddle World

claims.claim: Waddle World is currently only available in the Philippines.

evidence.quote: but it's only available in the Philippines for now.
But it's only available in the Philippines for now.

claims.claim: Social media consultant Matt Navarra posted links to the Apple App Store and Google Play store listings of Waddle World on X.

evidence.quote: Social media consultant Matt Navarra has posted links to its Apple App Store and Google Play store listings on X.

claims.claim: Based on app store listings, Waddle World first became available in late September.

evidence.quote: Based on those listings, the game first became available in late September.

claims.claim: Waddle World is a 16-bit game described by Meta as a daily journal disguised as a pet.

evidence.quote: Waddle World is a 16-bit game that Meta describes as a "daily journal disguised as a pet."

claims.claim: Meta revealed the Muse Charm at its Connect event in September.

evidence.quote: It also revealed the "Muse Charm" at its Connect event in September.

claims.claim: The Muse Charm is an egg-shaped physical device designed to be an AI companion containing the Muse avatar.

evidence.quote: The Muse Charm, designed to be an AI companion, is an egg-shaped physical device like the Tamagotchi that contains your Muse avatar.

claims.claim: Meta is aiming to release the Muse Charm device in time for the holidays this December.

evidence.quote: Meta is aiming to release the device in time for the holidays this December.
